payload.title: Count unlabeled natural-sample items as missing coverage
payload.description: Current read-only reviews split report says natural_mix n300,sme_labeled0,no_label0 when none of the300 natural IDs have cached labels. This wrongly hides missing coverage. As an evaluator I need no_label to include every expected natural-sample item without a valid label, including absent cache records, not just ambiguous returned records. Adjacent regression must fail first on empty/partial cache, then pass with natural_size-minus-valid-label coverage and explicit missing/ambiguous counts. No private texts or paid calls; preserve existing labeled mix and heldout partitions.
